gt-2nYg.title: Google car: blue rope on bottom right bar
gt-2nYg.summary: In those backward-bar regions you can often see a blue rope on the bottom right bar. It can be hard to see, and then it just looks like a normal backward bar.

gt-7t14.title: Pole: green with white plate, road code
gt-7t14.summary: Most green poles have a white plate. Its first two characters tell you which road you are on.

gt-HQly.title: Landscape: tropical, rainforest
gt-HQly.summary: A tropical country, mostly covered by rainforest.

gt-HmBj.title: Landscape: completely flat farmland, built up
gt-HmBj.summary: The south is completely flat farmland and more built up than the flat north.

gt-LaQp.title: Google car: top right bar faces forward
gt-LaQp.summary: On most coverage the bar at the top right of the car points forward, so you see a line on its front-facing side.

gt-PGLM.title: Houses: pastel stone, rusty metal roofs
gt-PGLM.summary: Pastel-painted stone houses, often with rusty sheet metal roofs. Exposed white brick buildings are fairly common too.

gt-PUP5.title: Road lines: thin, single yellow centre line
gt-PUP5.summary: Solid white edge lines with a single yellow centre line, like Mexico, but noticeably thinner than Mexican lines.

differs.how: Mexican road lines are much thicker

gt-QYdU.title: Bollard: small white, two black stripes
gt-QYdU.summary: Small white bollards with two black stripes, found on road 1 northeast of Quetzaltenango.

gt-TOL4.title: Google car: top right bar faces backward
gt-TOL4.summary: In the southeast the same bar points backward instead, so that line is not on the forward-facing side.

gt-UW8N.title: Landscape: small dirt road in dense jungle
gt-UW8N.summary: A small dirt road through dense jungle, north of Tikal in the far north.

gt-UdGx.title: Coverage: sparse, especially in the north
gt-UdGx.summary: Not much coverage, especially in the north. Check which roads are covered on the map.

gt-VLvK.title: Phone numbers: start with 2
gt-VLvK.summary: Phone numbers starting with 2 are only found in the capital, Guatemala City.

gt-Wu24.title: Pole: white 'electricista' sticker
gt-Wu24.summary: Rectangular white stickers reading 'electricista' on poles are only in Guatemala City.

gt-acEC.title: Phone numbers: start with 6
gt-acEC.summary: Numbers starting with 6 belong to Guatemala Department only. Numbers starting with 7 are everywhere except there, and 3, 4 or 5 can be anywhere.

gt-bviD.title: Landscape: mountainous middle, flat ends
gt-bviD.summary: The middle of the country is mountainous, while the south and north are fairly flat.

gt-eusx.title: Road: rolling land, straight north-south
gt-eusx.summary: The PET-11 south of Las Pozas has gently rolling land and a road that runs straight north to south.

gt-gNVA.title: Landscape: fairly flat with gentle hills
gt-gNVA.summary: The north is fairly flat but slightly rolling, unlike the completely flat south.

gt-gZYw.title: Google car: grey with roof rack and mirrors
gt-gZYw.summary: A grey car with a roof rack and visible side mirrors, on all car coverage. Only Laos has a similar car.

differs.how: Laos has a similar grey car but a different landscape
Dominican car has thick black stripes on bars, mirrors hidden
Curaçao car has a black front

gt-hIlm.title: Landscape: huge lake among volcanoes
gt-hIlm.summary: Lago de Atitlán is by far the largest lake in the mountains, surrounded by mountains and some volcanoes.

gt-kyzr.title: Pole: painted pink, green or both
gt-kyzr.summary: Poles are very often painted pink, green, or a mix of both.

gt-lkgV.title: Google car: bottom bar missing black cap
gt-lkgV.summary: In the south and northeast, the bar also faces backward, but the bottom right bar is missing its thin black cap seen elsewhere.

gt-lw5V.title: Road: divided highway on concrete
gt-lw5V.summary: The CA9 between Escuintla and the coast is a divided highway with concrete pavement.

gt-mgoz.title: Sign: stop sign says ALTO
gt-mgoz.summary: Stop signs read ALTO, as in Mexico, Panama and Costa Rica.

gt-quLJ.title: Plate: short, blue or green tinge when blurred
gt-quLJ.summary: Short plates that look blue, or slightly green on the left side, once blurred.

gt-rIJc.title: Landscape: mountainous centre
gt-rIJc.summary: The central part of the country is generally mountainous.

gt-urVz.title: Plants: oil palm plantations
gt-urVz.summary: Oil palm plantations are mainly in the southwest and just north of the central mountains.

gt-wuun.title: Pole: fully green, with small plates
gt-wuun.summary: Fully green utility poles are mostly in the southeast, plus one road in the east and a stretch near the far northeast. They carry small plates that help find the road.

gt-xmWF.title: Coverage: trekker among Mayan temples
gt-xmWF.summary: A walking trekker with several Mayan temples, just west of Tikal. It has the biggest and most intact temples of any trekker here.
